specification.time_scale: absolute calendar step, separate baseline by landmark
specification.features: train-standardized baseline covariates and squares; current-state indicators; log1p(current run length); state by log1p(run length); all interacted with L/30
specification.penalty: fixed 0.01 L2 on coefficients for numerical stability; no outcome-based tuning
specification.competing_risks: cause-specific Cox; simultaneous hazard increments converted to coherent survival/CIF via exponential total hazard and proportional allocation
specification.status: exploratory pilot; model specification needs review before manuscript incorporation
specification.limitations: PH approximation; discrete tied event times; no validation tuning yet; no new-dataset uncertainty; not repeated neural training replicates
